
# --- Format ---
#type(scope): subject

# --- WHY is this change required? ---

# --- WHAT has changed? ---

# --- Supported types ---
# feat:     New feature
# fix:      Bug fix
# docs:     Documentation changes
# refactor: Code refactoring without feature or bug changes
# test:     Add or update tests
# chore:    Maintenance, docker, dependencies
#
# --- Allowed scopes ---
# booking, catalog, outbox, webhook, saga, redis, infra, docs
